title: Tinkering Tidepool Tinselfish
statement: A thumb-sized fish with fins like spun brass thread, it spends its days collecting shed bits of sea glass and arranging them into small, shimmering mosaics on a mossy slate ledge. When the tank lights dim to evening amber, it hums a faint bubble-click lullaby and gently rearranges everything one last time, never quite satisfied.
